item.title: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly in Cybersecurity — Week 41
item.description:
Author: Paul Ducklin
Date: 2023-10-13
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Phishing", "Ransomware", "Malware", "Critical Infrastructure Security"]
Summary:
  • Microsoft added AI-driven phishing protection to Outlook.
  • New ransomware decryption tools help victims recover data.
  • ShadowStrike malware targets enterprise VPNs using zero-day exploits.
  • Government agencies face breaches from third-party vendors.
  • Critical infrastructure suffers attacks from cybercrime groups.

item.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly in Cybersecurity – Week 42
item.description:
Author: Paul Lanzi
Date: 2023-10-20
Tags: ["Cybersecurity News", "Ransomware", "Phishing Attacks", "AI in Cybersecurity", "Security Updates"]
Summary:
  • Microsoft released security updates for Windows and Azure.
  • A new ransomware called DarkCrypt targets healthcare in North America.
  • DarkCrypt encrypts patient data and demands large ransoms.
  • AI-generated deepfake voices are used in phishing scams.
  • The cybersecurity community prepares for OneCon25 conference on AI security.

item.title: SentinelOne and the MITRE ATT&CKⓇ Evaluations: Enterprise 2025
item.description:
Author: SentinelOne
Date: 2023-12-14
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Endpoint Detection and Response", "MITRE ATT&CK", "Artificial Intelligence", "Threat Detection"]
Summary:
  • MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations assess cybersecurity vendor performance.
  • SentinelOne led the 2025 Enterprise Evaluation with top scores.
  • The test simulated advanced threat actor tactics.
  • SentinelOne’s AI-driven platform enabled fast detection and response.
  • The solution showed strong visibility and low false positives.
  • This proves SentinelOne’s strength in threat detection and response.

item.title: From Obstacle to Accelerator: Custom Compliance for Cloud Security
item.description:
Author: SentinelOne
Date: 2023-05-11
Tags: ["Cloud Security", "Compliance", "Regulatory Requirements", "DevOps", "Cybersecurity Best Practices"]
Summary:
  • Cloud computing offers scalability and cost savings.
  • Compliance in cloud security is complex and critical.
  • Custom compliance tailors controls to specific regulations.
  • Automation and continuous monitoring improve compliance.
  • Integrating compliance into DevOps enhances security.
  • Training and incident planning support compliance efforts.

item.title: The Rise of AI Browsers: Smarter, Faster, and Far More Dangerous
item.description:
Author: The Lasso Team
Date: October 20, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Web Browsers", "Technology Innovation", "Human-Computer Interaction"]
Summary:
  • AI is transforming the browsing experience.
  • Browsers now use large language models.
  • They can summarize and interpret web content.
  • Users can give commands in natural language.
  • Browsers execute tasks autonomously across apps and systems.
